name: Google Cloud VPC Flow Logs and Cloud Storage usage logs
description: Two Google Cloud access-and-traffic feeds as the Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform indexes them: Compute Engine VPC Flow Logs (who talked to whom, on which port, how much) and Cloud Storage bucket usage logs (who called the storage API, on which bucket and object, with what result).
source: Google Cloud VPC Flow Logs record and Cloud Storage usage log CSV reference (docs.cloud.google.com); Cloud Logging LogEntry reference; Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform source type and Network Traffic CIM mapping docs; observed field lists and dev Splunk index from this pack's own sample data.

feed.label: Google Cloud VPC Flow Logs and Cloud Storage usage logs
feed.description: Network flow records between Compute Engine VMs, GKE pods and gateways, and HTTP-level access records for Cloud Storage buckets, both indexed as Cloud Logging or usage-log exports.

flow_log_entry_id.label: Log entry id
flow_log_entry_id.description: A unique id Cloud Logging assigns to one flow log entry; entries with the same project, timestamp and id are deduplicated.

flow_log_name.label: Log name
flow_log_name.description: The Cloud Logging log resource path the entry belongs to, for example projects/<id>/logs/compute.googleapis.com%2Fvpc_flows.

flow_log_time.label: Log entry time
flow_log_time.description: The time Cloud Logging attributes to the entry; for a flow log this sits close to the flow's end_time.

flow_receive_time.label: Log receive time
flow_receive_time.description: The time Cloud Logging received the entry, not when the flow happened.

flow_start_time.label: Flow start time
flow_start_time.description: Timestamp of the first observed packet during the flow's aggregation interval.

flow_end_time.label: Flow end time
flow_end_time.description: Timestamp of the last observed packet during the flow's aggregation interval.

flow_reporter.label: Reporter
flow_reporter.description: Which side reported the flow: the source VM, the destination VM, or a Cloud Interconnect/VPN gateway on either side.

flow_src_ip.label: Source address
flow_src_ip.description: The connection's source IP address; populated for every flow.

flow_dest_ip.label: Destination address
flow_dest_ip.description: The connection's destination IP address; populated for every flow.

flow_reporting_device.label: Reporting side address
flow_reporting_device.description: The address of whichever side produced this record: the source address when reporter is SRC, the destination address when reporter is DEST.

flow_src_port.label: Source port
flow_src_port.description: The connection's source port; populated only for TCP and UDP flows.

flow_dest_port.label: Destination port
flow_dest_port.description: The connection's destination port; populated only for TCP and UDP flows.

flow_protocol.label: IP protocol
flow_protocol.description: The IANA protocol number of the connection (for example 6 for TCP); unpopulated for RDMA.

flow_bytes_sent.label: Bytes sent
flow_bytes_sent.description: Estimated user-payload bytes sent from the source to the destination during the aggregation interval; absent for dropped traffic.

flow_packets_sent.label: Packets sent
flow_packets_sent.description: Estimated packets sent from the source to the destination during the aggregation interval; absent for dropped traffic.

flow_rtt_msec.label: Round-trip time
flow_rtt_msec.description: Round-trip time in milliseconds measured during the aggregation interval.

flow_duration.label: Flow duration
flow_duration.description: The flow's duration, worked out from start_time and end_time.

gcp_project_id.label: Google Cloud project id
gcp_project_id.description: The id of the Google Cloud project that owns the VM, VPC or subnetwork side of the flow named in the same record.

gcp_vm_name.label: VM instance name
gcp_vm_name.description: The Compute Engine instance name on one side of the flow.

gcp_vm_zone.label: VM zone
gcp_vm_zone.description: The Compute Engine zone the VM on one side of the flow runs in.

gcp_vm_region.label: VM region
gcp_vm_region.description: The Compute Engine region the VM on one side of the flow runs in.

gcp_vpc_name.label: VPC network name
gcp_vpc_name.description: The name of the VPC network one side of the flow belongs to.

gcp_subnetwork_name.label: Subnetwork name
gcp_subnetwork_name.description: The name of the subnet one side of the flow belongs to, when the flow is scoped to one.

gcp_subnetwork_id.label: Subnetwork id
gcp_subnetwork_id.description: The Monitored Resource's own numeric id for the reporting subnetwork.

gke_cluster_name.label: GKE cluster name
gke_cluster_name.description: The name of the GKE cluster a flow endpoint's pod runs in.

gke_cluster_location.label: GKE cluster location
gke_cluster_location.description: The location of the GKE cluster a flow endpoint's pod runs in.

gke_pod_name.label: GKE pod name
gke_pod_name.description: The name of the pod at one end of the flow.

gke_pod_namespace.label: GKE pod namespace
gke_pod_namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the pod at one end of the flow.

gke_service_name.label: GKE service name
gke_service_name.description: The name of a Kubernetes Service fronting the source pod, when the flow's source side is a service-backed pod.

gke_service_namespace.label: GKE service namespace
gke_service_namespace.description: The namespace of the Kubernetes Service named in the same record.

flow_resource_kind.label: Monitored resource kind
flow_resource_kind.description: The kind of Google Cloud resource the flow log entry is attributed to; every sampled flow log entry carries gce_subnetwork, a Compute Engine subnetwork.

gcs_time_micros.label: Request time
gcs_time_micros.description: The time the request completed, in microseconds since the Unix epoch.

gcs_client_ip.label: Client address
gcs_client_ip.description: The IP address the request was made from.

gcs_client_ip_type.label: Client address type
gcs_client_ip_type.description: Which IP version the client address is: 1 for IPv4, 2 for IPv6.

gcs_client_ip_region.label: Client address region
gcs_client_ip_region.description: A column Google's usage log format reserves for a future client-region value; not populated today.

gcs_http_method.label: HTTP method
gcs_http_method.description: The HTTP method of the request, for example GET or PATCH.

gcs_request_uri.label: Request URI
gcs_request_uri.description: The URI of the request, including its path and any query string; the add-on also splits it into a path, a query string, a reconstructed url and that url's length.

gcs_status.label: HTTP status
gcs_status.description: The HTTP status code the server returned for the request; the add-on also carries its text reason phrase.

gcs_request_bytes.label: Request bytes
gcs_request_bytes.description: The number of bytes sent in the request.

gcs_response_bytes.label: Response bytes
gcs_response_bytes.description: The number of bytes sent in the response.

gcs_total_bytes.label: Total bytes
gcs_total_bytes.description: Request and response bytes added together.

gcs_response_time.label: Time to serve
gcs_response_time.description: How long the request took to serve, in microseconds; the add-on also carries a millisecond conversion.

gcs_server_host.label: Request host
gcs_server_host.description: The host named in the original request, for example storage.googleapis.com or a custom domain fronting the bucket.

gcs_referer.label: HTTP referer
gcs_referer.description: The HTTP Referer header value sent with the request, when the client sent one.

gcs_referer_domain.label: Referer domain
gcs_referer_domain.description: The host portion the add-on extracts from the HTTP referer.

gcs_user_agent.label: User agent
gcs_user_agent.description: The User-Agent header value of the request.

gcs_user_agent_length.label: User agent length
gcs_user_agent_length.description: The length, in characters, of the request's User-Agent string.

gcs_request_id.label: Request id
gcs_request_id.description: Google's own identifier for the request.

gcs_operation.label: Storage operation
gcs_operation.description: The Cloud Storage operation name the request performed, for example GET_Object; empty for requests the usage log does not classify as an object operation.

gcs_bucket.label: Bucket name
gcs_bucket.description: The bucket named in the request.

gcs_object.label: Object name
gcs_object.description: The object named in the request; empty for a request that is not scoped to one object.

gcs_vendor_product.label: Vendor product
gcs_vendor_product.description: A constant the add-on sets on every Cloud Storage usage log event, naming the vendor and product.

google:gcp:compute:vpc_flows.description: Compute Engine VPC Flow Logs, indexed from a Cloud Logging export: one record per side per flow, with connection, byte/packet counts, and the VM, VPC, subnetwork or GKE pod context of each side.
google:gcp:compute:vpc_flows.note: jsonPayload holds the record nested under src_/dest_ instance, vpc and gke_details objects; the add-on also aliases the same values to flat, CIM-style top-level fields.

google:gcp:buckets:accesslogs.description: Cloud Storage bucket server access logs (the 'usage log'): one CSV row per storage API request, with the client, method, URI, status and byte counts. Maps to the CIM Change data model.
google:gcp:buckets:accesslogs.note: Indexed from the bucket-delivered usage-log CSV object; the add-on both keeps the raw cs_/sc_ column names and adds derived and CIM alias fields.

flow_time_basis.text: A flow record carries four times: timestamp (the LogEntry's own time, close to end_time), start_time and end_time (the flow's aggregation window), and receiveTimestamp (when Cloud Logging received the entry). Bound a search on start_time and end_time, not on receiveTimestamp or _time alone.

reporter_perspective.text: reporter (SRC, DEST, SRC_GATEWAY or DEST_GATEWAY) says which side produced the record; dvc and the add-on's dest/direction fields are computed relative to it. The same flow can be reported from both ends, so counting records without grouping on reporter double-counts flows.

rtt_tcp_only.text: rtt_msec is populated only for TCP flows reported from VMs; it is absent for UDP, ICMP or gateway-reported flows.

gke_service_cap.text: A flow's GKE service list is capped at two entries; a pod fronted by more services reports MANY_SERVICES instead of naming them.

ids_look_alike.text: insertId (vpc_flows), s_request_id (accesslogs) and resource.labels.subnetwork_id are all opaque tokens that look alike; none is a join key to either of the others.

gcs_time_broken.text: This sourcetype's props.conf TIME_PREFIX cannot match the real CSV content (no bracketed timestamp is ever present), so Splunk indexes _time at ingest time, not the request's own time_micros value. Always read and sort on time_micros, not _time.

referer_domain_bug.text: The add-on's http_referrer_domain extraction can drop leading digits from a numeric host: a referrer host of 99.88.77.66 was observed to yield http_referrer_domain 88.77.66, not the full address.
